detail.ownerHint: These actions only succeed if the listing is yours.
detail.photosHint: References from before real photos could be uploaded: they have no picture.

pricing.integer: A price must be a whole number of cents.

publish.title: List a space
publish.subtitle: Describe the space, set your prices, pick the period.
publish.previewHint: What drivers will see, updated as you type.

edit.title: Edit the listing
edit.subtitle: Access instructions, photos, vehicles, prices and dates: change them all here, without unpublishing.
edit.placeLocked: The address and box identify the space: to change them, publish a new listing.
edit.bookingsKept: Requests and bookings already made still stand, even outside the new dates.
edit.savedBody: Drivers already see the new version.
edit.notEditableBody: Only a published listing can be edited, and only by its owner.

field.accessHint: Door code, floor, landmarks. Shared with the renter after confirmation.
field.photosHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, ten at most. The first one is the cover.

validation.reversed: The end must follow the start.

map.title: Find a space
map.subtitle: Every space published in France, on the map.
map.approximateHint: The address has no exact match: the pin sits on the nearest street.
map.unplacedHint: Their address could not be recognised. They stay visible in the list.
map.attribution: Addresses geocoded by the Base Adresse Nationale.

mapSearch.label: Search an address
mapSearch.hint: At least 3 characters. Add the city to narrow the suggestions.
mapSearch.noneNearby: No space within one kilometre. The closest ones are listed first.

criteria.noTier: No space offers this rate. All of them stay visible.
criteria.acceptedHint: Tick everything the space can take. “Electric car” implies a charging point.
criteria.acceptedRequired: Name at least one accepted vehicle.
criteria.noVehicle: No space takes this vehicle. All of them stay visible.
criteria.undeclaredKept_one: {{count}} space stated nothing and stays visible.
criteria.undeclaredKept_other: {{count}} spaces stated nothing and stay visible.
criteria.stayIncomplete: Choose both the arrival and the departure.
criteria.stayHidden_one: {{count}} other, booked or closed on these dates, is not shown.
criteria.stayHidden_other: {{count}} others, booked or closed on these dates, are not shown.

ticket.title: Starting rate
ticket.caption: The lowest published price, brought down to one night.

search.title: Search around an address
search.body: Type an address anywhere in France: every space shows up on the map, closest first.

dates.title: Pick your dates
dates.body: The price is worked out before you send, from the owner’s rates: by the day, the week or the month.

park.title: Park
park.body: Once the request is confirmed, you receive the access instructions: door code, level, landmarks.

why.title: Neighbors everywhere, a price that holds.
why.noFees: in fees added once the price is shown

owner.title: A space sitting idle? Rent it to your neighbors.
owner.body: Set a price by the day, the week or the month, pick the period, and confirm every request yourself.

home.pitch: Search an address anywhere in France, say which vehicle and for how long. Available spaces show up on the map.
home.seeAll: See every space on the map

local.title: Everywhere in France
local.body: Every space is listed by someone who lives in the neighborhood. Around the address you search, the closest come first.

price.title: The quoted price is the price paid
price.body: The estimate shown before you send is what the owner will charge. No fee appears afterwards.

trust.title: The owner confirms
trust.body: A request commits to nothing until it is accepted. Without an answer, it expires on its own.

refused.format: A photo was not added: only JPEG, PNG and WebP are accepted.
refused.size: A photo was not added: it is larger than 10 MB.
